name: Infantile Cholestasis: Biliary Atresia versus Neonatal Hepatitis

reference.source: Nelson Textbook of Pediatrics 22nd Edition Vol 1+2 (topic map; text rewritten, no verbatim copy)
reference.pathophysiology: Obliterated ducts trap bile staining stools pale while hepatocellular giant cells cholestase reversibly; early portoenterostomy restores flow clearing pigment, and unrelieved obstruction fibroses cirrhosing.
additionalDifferentials: Atresia versus hepatitis by course and biopsy
Alagille versus PFIC by GGT and genes
Choledochal versus atresia by cyst and age
